title: Ludus
author: Birsen Ekim Özen
description: Humanity once thrived in a world where technology solved every problem: beauty at a glance, adventures at the blink of an eye, and a virtual universe more dazzling than reality itself. Life seemed effortless until the invasion began. Colossal purple UFOs appeared in the skies, unleashing armies of mercurial cannons that turned cities into graveyards and people into ashes. With the outside world reduced to silence and daily survival limited to what can be seen during one hour of television, a group of neighbors trapped inside their building struggle to make sense of the destruction.
